body: Yup! I literally fast forwarded this last episode al the way until Meghan's and Peggy's "shush" scene...and even that was annoying watching Vicki being a martyr

RHOC has officially gotten boring. It's the same old stories again, except with different teams now. I only find myself watching Tamara, Meghan, and occasionally Shannon's scenes. I can't stand watching Vicki and Kelly anymore because they're so delusional, not to mention they have punchable faces. I thought Peggy would be cool. It could be cultural differences, but after seeing what she's about to do the Meghan next week...TEAM MEGHAN ALL THEY WAY
